⌈
The function
ara::crypto::cryp::MessageAu-
thnCodeCtx::MakeSignature
shall create a Signature object that includes the
computed message authentication code (MAC), the AlgId configured for this Mes-
sageAuthnCodeCtx and all information required by the CryptoObject interface. The
function shall return
kProcessingNotFinished
, if a MAC is not yet available.
